verdict.rationale: A public web filing portal could plausibly offer an analytics or cookie-tracking opt-out, so the privacy-posture axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, cookies, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The items cover only search, filing, ordering, accounts, payment, and bot-wall probe results.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
